text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Japanese Derby is almost
upon us.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today, a press conference is being held
for all the
Umamusume who are
registered to run in the
race.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Whoa... I just took a peek inside, and there are so many reporters!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ungh, I'm shaking...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This is her first press conference, so it's
only
natural for her to be tense.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I decide to suggest something to help
calm her
nerves.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...Really?! Anything I want?!
choice_data_list: 終わったら、何でも好きなの食べに行くぞ！
終わったら、何でも好きなの食べに行こう！
choice_data_list_en: When we're done, we're getting whatever food you want!
When we're done, let's go eat whatever you want!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... My ears aren't playing tricks on
me,
right?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: And by anything, you mean... anything, correct?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Even the Carrot Overload Meat
Mountain
Monstrosity Set at the ramen
place everyone
goes to by the academy?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
And... can we also drop by the diner
afterwards so
I can grab an Ultimate
Mega Max Carrot Tower
Parfait?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Okay... Just breathe...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I can do this. Press conference, red
carpet—bring
it on!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...Heheheh, you bet'cha!
choice_data_list: よ、よかった（目つきが変わった……）

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Thanks for the encouragement, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
You'd better pay close attention to the
press
conference!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Special Week! You're next. Please get
ready!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ah, okay! I'm coming!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
The Japanese Derby is almost here! Tell
us how
you're feeling, Special Week.
What are your
motivations for
participating this race?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Of course! Um...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
My dream is to become the top
Umamusume in all
of Japan. And that's
why I decided to run in the
Derby.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I wanna get stronger and win the Derby
to show
both of my moms just how
capable I've become.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...I have one more reason for wanting to
win.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
You have another reason? Could you
please
elaborate?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I'm standing here today thanks to a few
people
who mean a whole lot to me.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
My mother who gave birth to me, my
mother who
raised me, and...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
The person who's been teaching me up
until
now—my trainer!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I want to make my moms proud by being
the best
in Japan! And I wanna make my
trainer a Derby
trainer!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: And that is why I will win!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The room erupts into applause and
cheers, and
Special Week looks over to
me with a huge smile
on her face.
